description: This file contains the implementation of a custom logger class DeepEvalLogger that integrates with DeepEval's platform for tracing and logging of LiteLLM operations. It includes methods for logging success and failure events, preparing trace data, and interfacing with external APIs.

classes.name: DeepEvalLogger
classes.description: A custom logger class that extends CustomLogger to send trace and log data to DeepEval's platform.

methods.name: __init__(self, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the DeepEvalLogger, retrieves configuration from environment variables, and validates the environment.

methods.name: log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a success event to DeepEval's platform.

methods.name: log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a failure event to DeepEval's platform.

methods.name: _prepare_trace_api( self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time, is_success )
methods.description: Prepares the trace API payload including start/end times, success status, and trace details.

methods.name: _sync_event_handler( self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time, is_success )
methods.description: Handles sending trace data synchronously to the external API.

methods.name: _async_event_handler( self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time, is_success )
methods.description: Handles sending trace data asynchronously to the external API.

methods.name: _create_base_api_span( self, kwargs, standard_logging_object, start_time, end_time, is_success )
methods.description: Creates a base span object containing trace details for the main API call, including success/failure output and timing.

methods.name: _create_trace_api( self, base_api_span, standard_logging_object, start_time, end_time, litellm_environment, )
methods.description: Constructs the full trace API object, including all span data and environment info.
